summary: Male who fled on foot after rolling his vehicle off Wilkerson Pass (outstanding warrants); deputies and fire personnel searched in darkness but pulled back. A SARDOC trailing dog picked out his trail from the towed vehicle's headrest scent and found him about a half mile away, hypothermic with spinal and head injuries and lacerations.
responding_agency: SARDOC; Park County deputies; fire personnel
notes: Date Monday-verified. Subject ran from rollover due to warrants; found lying in tall grass in a sunken aspen grove.
